format._comment: Luna Base look = editorial-dark, stated explicitly so it is preserved exactly even if template defaults change.

images._comment: Where the THUMBNAIL and SOCIAL images come from. provider 'canva' = Claude writes a fresh clickbait prompt per piece and generates the image with the connected Canva tools at session time, then exports PNG. provider 'svg' = legacy inline SVG. NOTE: in-article blog figures are ALWAYS SVG regardless. Sizes verified June 2026.
images._provider_options: canva (requires the Canva connector) | svg (no external dependency)
images._style_note: Header may carry one short, bold clickbait HEADLINE (<=8 words, real wording). The ONLY brand wordmark allowed is exactly company.domain, small in a bottom-corner FOOTER - no tagline, no other text, no numbers unless real. Method: let Canva generate the visual + headline + wordmark, then AUDIT the editable text - fix the headline if mangled, make the wordmark read exactly company.domain, and DELETE any junk/gibberish/duplicate text - then commit. Never trust the generator spelling.

sizes._blog_thumbnail_note: Open Graph / link-preview standard (1.91:1). Keep headline + faces in center 1080x600 safe zone.
sizes._linkedin_note: Square feed image for strong presence. Landscape/link alt: 1200x627.
sizes._facebook_note: Portrait 4:5 for max mobile real estate. Square alt: 1080x1080; landscape/link alt: 1200x630.
